summary: Dogfood the Guru Benchmark skill across agent runtimes
description: Depends on GB-111. Run isolated Hermes and Codex skill discovery/invocation smokes against public-safe synthetic prompts, record bounded runtime evidence, and repair contract or routing defects found.
acceptance: Hermes lists and loads the installed skill in an isolated profile or HOME, Codex identifies the repo-local skill or installed bundle, and a synthetic invocation follows the required Guru Verdict shape without fabricated expert claims.
